name: Mangatan
subtitle: Read, look up, and mine.
description: The official sideloading source for Mangatan, a Mangayomi fork focused on dictionary lookup, OCR, subtitle mining, and Anki export.

apps.name: Mangatan
apps.subtitle: Read, look up, and mine
apps.localizedDescription: Mangatan is a Mangayomi fork focused on Yomitan-style dictionary lookup, OCR overlays, subtitle mining, and Anki export.

versions.localizedDescription:
What's changed

• Added Chimahon•style YouTube support with video, channel, playlist, live•stream, caption, alternate•audio, recent•search, preferred•quality, library•channel, OCR, and mining integration.
• Redesigned Yomitan kanji results into a compact Meaning, Readings, and Statistics layout, with popup paging through keyboard and hardware volume controls.
• Added shared dictionary lookup history, safe display•name aliases, and Yomitan•compatible manual and automatic dictionary updates.
• Added selected•chapter pre•OCR, configurable parallel OCR, in•reader OCR engine selection, stable page•to•page progress, and two•finger manga/video OCR gestures.
• Added Chimahon•compatible subtitle cleanup filters for speaker labels, bracketed text, uppercase cues, music markers, multiline merging, and custom regular expressions.
• Added E•Ink manga mode and a thumbnail page•preview grid with direct page jumps.
• Added HEIC, HEIF, and JPEG XL discovery and MIME handling for local manga, archives, and EPUB content.
• Fixed custom local manga folders on other Windows drives and improved local•folder rescanning.
• Improved iOS AnkiMobile integration and the embedded Mihon bridge, including runtime retry and launch•safety coverage.
• Added automated stable AUR publishing and corrected cross•platform release tagging and artifact names.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.0.9...v1.1.0

What's changed

• Added [Chimahon•compatible immersion statistics](https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/pull/65), including novel and manga reading tracking, Anki mining stats, reader statistics sheets, backup, and sync support.
• Added Yomitan kanji dictionary imports and Yomitan•style kanji lookup by selecting a kanji inside a word popup.
• Fixed dictionary WebView refresh after theme, language, and dictionary changes.
• Fixed marking multiple selected manga or novel chapters as unread.
• Fixed bookmarks so they follow the chapter currently being read instead of the chapter originally opened.
• Added the novel reader Text Size control to reader settings.
• Added AVIF page support and preserved OCR loading progress when changing pages.
• Improved iOS sideload and Mihon bridge compatibility, and added Linux release packaging.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/1Selxo/Mangatan/compare/v1.0.8...v1.0.9
